characters.description: A hunter, archer, and alchemist linked to the Malefic Viper. Jake hunts in the upper atmosphere with a wind hawk while his primordial patron watches his progress and considers him an unusually promising ally.
characters.name: Jake Thayne

characters.description: A primordial god, Jake's patron, and the source of his alchemical legacy. He begins rebuilding the Malefic Order, recalls former members to leadership, and treats Jake as a friend instead of an ordinary subordinate.
characters.name: Malefic Viper

characters.description: The wind-manipulating hawk who hunts beside Jake and corrects his aerial movement. Jake gives him the name Hawkie after their partnership carries them into battles against the cloud continent's elementals.
characters.name: Hawkie

characters.description: The Principal City Lord managing a tiny pylon settlement for its absent, undisclosed owner. She studies the settlement interface, plans for future residents, and worries that its four occupants cannot withstand a stronger group alone.
characters.name: Miranda Wells

characters.description: One of the four original residents of the hidden pylon settlement. He belongs to Miranda's small group and helps maintain the foothold while its owner is away.
characters.name: Hank

characters.description: One of the hidden settlement's original residents and Hank's daughter. She is part of Miranda's small group holding the valley in its owner's absence.
characters.name: Louise

characters.description: A space and kinetic caster leading a displaced five-person team. Repeated long-distance escapes have brought his group to the valley, where he asks Miranda for temporary refuge and possible cooperation.
characters.name: Neil

characters.description: The archer and scout in Neil's team. She enters the valley ahead of her companions to examine the settlement before the stronger visiting party approaches Miranda's group.
characters.name: Eleanor

characters.description: Neil's defender and blacksmith. She arrives with his displaced team while Silas continues treating a curse-related wound that has resisted a quick recovery.
characters.name: Christen

characters.description: The healer and lie detector in Neil's five-person team. He treats Christen's lingering wound and helps the visitors test what Miranda's group says about the valley and its unseen owner.
characters.name: Silas

characters.description: A magic-swordsman hybrid and one of Neil's long-standing companions. He reaches the valley with the rest of the displaced party after their repeated spatial escapes.
characters.name: Levi

characters.description: Neil's cousin, a rival inheritor of a powerful space-mage path, and leader of the force pursuing his team. She can track Neil through his inherited class and the legendary spatial orb he won.
characters.name: Abby

characters.description: Abby's father and a manipulative leader among the forces besieging the lodge. He tries to pressure Miranda into surrender after the defenders retreat behind overlapping barriers.
characters.name: Donald

characters.description: The god who rules the Brimstone Conglomerate and rejects the returning Malefic Order's ultimatum. The Malefic Viper responds by entering his divine realm.
characters.name: Brimstone Hegemon

characters.description: The Augur of Hope who directs a coordinated assault on a pylon defender. His class prevents him from joining the battle directly, so he guides the rituals, containment, ranged attacks, and explosives that secure victory.
characters.name: Jacob

characters.description: Jake's brother and the principal authority within Earth's Court of Shadows. He directs his faction's prolonged hunt for a pylon defender while enduring the mental pressure of a dangerous darkness-and-lightning legacy.
characters.name: Caleb

characters.description: The god connected to Caleb's dangerous legacy. Umbra directed Caleb to accept the darkness-and-lightning power now used by the Court of Shadows.
characters.name: Umbra

characters.description: A D-grade Mystsong Hawk, Hawkie's mate, and guardian of their egg. Jake names her Mystie as the hawks prepare a records-enhancing incubation ritual and ask him to contribute the Storm Elemental's orb.
characters.name: Mystie

characters.description: A leader at a death-affinity pylon settlement. He prepares a ritual intended to let living people join the undead, but refuses to regard his deceased girlfriend Lyra as a resource to be spent.
characters.name: Casper

characters.description: Casper's deceased girlfriend, now a Blight Wraith bound to him through a legendary locket. Others see her as an extension of Casper's power, an interpretation he firmly rejects.
characters.name: Lyra

characters.description: Casper's co-operator in preparing a large underground ritual for living people who wish to become undead. She urges him to treat Lyra's condition as a usable advantage.
characters.name: Priscilla

characters.description: Miranda's assistant and a member of the delegation sent to contact the nearby fort. She travels beside Miranda as Jake's settlement begins negotiating from a position of superior force.
characters.name: Lillian

characters.description: The level-49 leader of a sixteen-person caravan newly accepted into the settlement. He joins Miranda's party on its first direct approach to the nearby fort.
characters.name: Mikkel

characters.description: The suspicious leader of a nearby fort. He initially keeps Miranda's delegation at a distance because he fears that negotiation skills could influence him.
characters.name: Phillip

characters.description: A sapient D-grade bovine controller holding human captives under mental domination. It engineered repeated herd attacks on the fort to strengthen both the human defenders and a future D-grade herd leader.
characters.name: Minotaur Mindchief

characters.description: The newly hatched daughter of Hawkie and Mystie. The female chick begins gaining levels almost immediately while her parents and Jake share in her early care.
characters.name: Sylphie

characters.description: A regenerative pugilist whose power rises as her health falls. She returns to defeat the Slothful Warden, the final boss she failed to reach during her tutorial, and dedicates the victory to Valhall.
characters.name: Carmen

characters.description: An underground fungal creature that Jake identifies as the target of his specialized fungicide work.
characters.name: Indigo Fungus Mycorrhiza

characters.description: A level-62 preacher leading roughly four hundred followers. He seeks a meeting with Haven's owner and presses Miranda for permission to establish a major temple in the growing settlement.
characters.name: Kenneth

characters.description: Three allied gods affiliated with the Malefic Viper. They invite Miranda to their realm and offer her a blessing because of her service as Jake's city lord.
characters.name: Ladies of the Verdant Lagoon

characters.description: A Haven sculptor and former combat fire mage who now shapes stone, metal, and glass through craftwork. He accepts a confidential city-office audition to produce statues for a temple under construction.
characters.name: Felix

characters.description: Jacob's standing guardian at a Sanct Domo leadership meeting. He remains close while the noncombatant Augur directs the immense pylon city's affairs.
characters.name: Bertram

characters.description: An unnamed wind-manipulating hawk who hunts beside Jake and helps him improve his movement in the air.
characters.name: Wind Hawk

characters.description: One of the hidden settlement's four original residents and Hank's son. He helps maintain the small foothold while its owner is absent.
characters.name: Mark

characters.description: A surviving follower of Abby and Donald who reports that Donald murdered his sister, helping Jake assess the pair's treatment of their own people.
characters.name: Chris

characters.description: A D-grade Mystsong Hawk guarding an egg while her mate gathers resources for its incubation formation.
characters.name: Mystsong Hawk

characters.description: A Haven craftsperson who makes the eleven timed injectors commissioned for Jake's prepared operation against the underground fungus.
characters.name: Arnold
